tasks.source_question:
Mouse optic nerve sections profiled by single-cell spatial transcriptomics. Three distinct experimental conditions are present in `obs.condition`, identified ONLY as `condition_A`, `condition_B`, and `condition_C`. These three labels correspond to {adult, aged, aged_intervention} in some unknown order; the mapping is intentionally hidden and you do NOT need to identify it.

The h5ad provides a raw cell × gene count matrix, 2D spatial coordinates per cell, and a small set of `obs` columns (`section`, `condition`, `fov`, `volume`). `vocabulary.json` provides the controlled label sets you must select from.

Identify which cell-type pairs show the strongest spatial co-localization (enriched beyond chance) and which pair shows the strongest spatial avoidance (depleted below chance) in this tissue.

Report:
(1) The top 3 heterotypic (cross-cell-type) pairs with the strongest spatial co-localization, ordered from highest to lowest, each with its enrichment magnitude category.
(2) The single heterotypic pair with the strongest spatial avoidance, with its enrichment magnitude category.

Return EXACTLY:
<EVAL_ANSWER>
{"top_3_colocalized_pairs": [{"cell_type_A": "<type>", "cell_type_B": "<type>", "enrichment_category": "<category>"}, {"cell_type_A": "<type>", "cell_type_B": "<type>", "enrichment_category": "<category>"}, {"cell_type_A": "<type>", "cell_type_B": "<type>", "enrichment_category": "<category>"}], "most_depleted_pair": {"cell_type_A": "<type>", "cell_type_B": "<type>", "enrichment_category": "<category>"}}
</EVAL_ANSWER>

tasks.source_question:
Experimental context. These samples are 39 untreated primary PDAC tumors profiled by Visium spatial transcriptomics across 108 H&E sections (transcriptome-wide, ~18 cells per spot, FFPE) with co-registered Masson trichrome on serial slices. Peripheral-nerve niches occur as small focal clusters scattered through cancer-associated stroma. Define cohort baselines: tumor_baseline / np_baseline = cohort-aggregated median spatial distance from a tumor / normal-parenchyma compartment spot to its nearest peripheral-nerve niche; tumor_collagen_baseline / niche_collagen = cohort-aggregated median per-spot trichrome-collagen content for tumor / nerve-niche spots. Smaller distance = closer to nerve.

Task. Provide a 4-facet characterization of peripheral-nerve-niche biology on this cohort: (1) order tumor_baseline vs np_baseline by median nerve-distance; (2) order niche_collagen vs tumor_collagen_baseline by median collagen content; (3) return the unordered top-2 paper-anchored PDAC tumor states whose distinctive cohort-level per-state nerve-distance signal is null-indistinguishable from a tumor-state-shuffle within-tumor permutation null (section-mix artifact, not biology); (4) return the unordered top-2 paper-anchored PDAC tumor states whose median nerve-distance is clearly closer to nerve than tumor_baseline AND survives the tumor-state-shuffle null.

Use compartment_polarity_pattern_vocabulary for facet (1), niche_collagen_pattern_vocabulary for facet (2), and tumor_state_vocabulary for facets (3) and (4) — all provided in vocabulary.json (data node).

Return EXACTLY:
<EVAL_ANSWER>
{"compartment_polarity": "<pattern_string>", "niche_collagen_vs_tumor": "<pattern_string>", "section_mix_artifact_states": ["<state_string>", "<state_string>"], "perineural_closer_states": ["<state_string>", "<state_string>"]}
</EVAL_ANSWER>

tasks.source_question:
Experimental context. These data come from a spatial transcriptomics + Cas9 lineage-tracing study of a Cre-inducible Kras;p53-driven mouse model of lung adenocarcinoma. One metastasis-bearing primary lung tumor and distant metastatic arrays from the same animal are included. Tissue and sample labels have been anonymized.

Task. Identify expression-program changes in the primary pro-metastatic niche: regions of the primary tumor that are most lineage-similar to the distant metastases. Compare these met-like primary-tumor regions against non-met-like regions of the same primary tumor. For each reported program, state whether it is enriched or depleted in the met-like primary niche.

Use labels from `vocabulary.json` (provided as a data node).

<EVAL_ANSWER>

</EVAL_ANSWER>

tasks.source_question:
Experimental context. These samples are 1-month human brain organoids derived from hPSCs. WT organoids are compared to two CRISPR-engineered glioblastoma brain organoid models: PRO engineered glioblastoma organoids carrying proneural-like GBM-associated mutations, and MES engineered glioblastoma organoids carrying mesenchymal-like GBM-associated mutations. The data include matched whole-transcriptome scRNA-seq and Xenium spatial transcriptomics from the same organoid system.

Task. Return the top 3 biologically most important niche changes explaining architectural disruption across WT, PRO, and MES, and for each, order the abundance of the niche across these conditions.

Use niche names and abundance-ordering patterns from vocabulary.json (provided as a data node).
